test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A competitive exam is to be held on a particular day. The examiner who has to supervise the exam, enters the examination room 30 minutes before 2:30 hours. He came 40 minutes before the student who was 20 minutes late for the exam. At what time will the examination start?
solution:
The supervisor enters the examination room 30 minutes before 2:30 hours ⇒ It means he came at 2:00 hours (2:30 - 00:30)

He came 40 minutes before the student who was 20 minutes late for the exam ⇒ It means the student came at 2:40 hours (2:00 + 00:40)

The student was 20 mins late for the exam ⇒ It means the examination started at** 2:20 hours** (2:40 - 00:20)

Hence,** 'option 4'** is the correct answer.
